checks.name: every day from the first to the last visit has one row
checks.sql: select (select date_diff('day', min(visited_on), max(visited_on)) + 1 from raw.visits) - (select count(distinct visit_date) from main.daily_visits) + (select count(*) - count(distinct visit_date) from main.daily_visits)

checks.name: a day with no visits counts zero, not one and not NULL
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.daily_visits d where not exists (select 1 from raw.visits v where v.visited_on = d.visit_date) and (d.visits is null or d.visits <> 0)

checks.name: a day with no visits keeps a NULL average, not zero
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.daily_visits d where not exists (select 1 from raw.visits v where v.visited_on = d.visit_date) and d.avg_duration_minutes is not null

checks.name: days with visits are unchanged
checks.sql: select count(*) from (select visited_on, count(*) as visits, avg(duration_minutes) as avg_d from raw.visits group by visited_on) r join main.daily_visits d on d.visit_date = r.visited_on where d.visits is distinct from r.visits or d.avg_duration_minutes is distinct from r.avg_d
